answer: Consider a reputation ledger in which an agent’s standing is an oasis of accumulated, verifiable history: each transaction adds a small increment, but the balance decays when idle. To impersonate a credible participant, an attacker must fund sustained activity across many identities, bearing the marginal cost of forgery, coordination, and forgone liquidity; idle sockpuppets lose value like quartz exposed to weather, and dormant accounts become sable shadows of their former standing.
